snippet.title: Gran Theft Lure - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
👵Get Gran Theft Lure on November 17th 2025 on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3907500/Gran_Theft_Lure/

Gran Theft Lure is a top-down arena shooter roguelite in which you play as your lovely gran being attacked by hordes of burglars. They can only be killed by luring or pushing them into your garden’s traps. Choose one of the 4 different game modes, and make them taste theft lure, or should we say failure!

The Spring game mode is a like a brawl mess where you have enemies that jumps into your garden from everywhere, and can overflow the arena if you don't handle them quick enough.
The Summer game mode is a strategic billard like where you must shoot in the football and strike packs of ennemies at once, moving and attacking in the optimal direction is key.
The Autumn game mode is what I call the hardcore mode of the game, as the shotgun you have is the slowest weapon of the game, hitting in a cone, you need to be clever about when you pull the trigger, and where to move, or you might miss the shot!
The Winter game mode is a bullet hell, where the enemies don't dare to step in your garden anymore, and simply shot you from outside. You need to run, dodge, and be quick like a shadow! You may deflect their bullet back at them, but the key here is to always look where to move and never stop running between the bullets!
